jobs.title: Research Scientist
jobs.description:
Job Title

PhD R&D Consultant
Salary Range

€3,000 – €8,000 per month (flexible part-time project role, salary determined by individual research expertise and professional competency)
Program Overview

Aleadin Consulting focuses on global high-end PhD talent recruitment and R&D empowerment
. We cooperate with leading global tech innovators to build an elite, flexible research platform for doctoral talents. Centering on high-potential fields including AI, New Energy and Advanced Manufacturing, we connect industrial cutting-edge R&D needs with outstanding overseas PhD professionals.
This fully remote, project-based role empowers STEM PhDs to leverage their academic strengths for industrial technological innovation. Talents can flexibly arrange work schedules to balance personal research and project tasks, achieving both academic improvement and lucrative returns by participating in high-value frontier R&D projects.
Cooperation Model

The initial cooperation period is 6 months, renewable based on project performance and mutual agreement. Excellent participants will be enrolled in our core talent pool, with priority access to continuous high-end R&D projects and long-term stable cooperation opportunities.
Core Responsibilities

Lead and execute cutting-edge R&D projects in your specialized field, deliver professional technical solutions, resolve core technical bottlenecks and ensure on-time project delivery. Covered research areas include:
Biomedical Science, Physics, AI & Computer Science, Chemistry, Materials Science, Imaging Technology, New Energy Batteries, Autonomous Driving, Industrial Software, Drones, Industrial Automation, Rail Transit, Geographic Information Surveying and Mechanical Manufacturing.
1. Provide professional technical assessment, experimental design and technical problem-solving to ensure smooth project progress and high-quality research outcomes;
2. Collaborate remotely with cross-functional R&D teams to bridge academic research and industrial scenarios, boosting research achievement commercialization;
3. Drive technological innovation and iteration, supporting patent development and technology transformation.
Ideal Candidate Profile

1. Hold a formal STEM doctoral degree with expertise matching our covered research fields;
2. A minimum of 3 years of post-PhD experience in industrial R&D, academic research or professional research institutions with solid theoretical and practical capabilities;
3. Able to work independently in remote settings, manage project schedules and deliver R&D targets efficiently;
4. Expert in at least one core tech field; experience in R&D project leadership or technological innovation is highly preferred.
Exclusive Talent Benefits

✅ Flexible Remote Work
: 100% remote project-based cooperation with flexible schedules, tailored for overseas researchers;
✅ Competitive Salary
: Graded, transparent remuneration aligned with your professional skills and project complexity;
✅ Continuous High-End Resources
: Access to our core talent pool and priority for long-term premium enterprise R&D projects;
✅ Dual Academic & Industrial Value
: Convert academic research into industrial achievements to enrich your portfolio and enhance industry influence.

Show more

Show less

Seniority level

Director

Employment type

Part-time

Industries

Computers and Electronics Manufacturing, Semiconductor Manufacturing, and Computer Hardware Manufacturing
